en: Today, I prepare some snacks, planning to take them to the church for afternoon tea.
As usual, I see Ayano near the church.
But this time she doesn't seem to be slacking off.
“It's easy, just follow me... Look, this is how you make a star!”
“Wow, I did it too, it really works!”
“There are more things you can make, like hot air balloons or butterflies.”
“I never knew rubber bands could be this fun!”
“Just never shoot them at people, okay?!”
“Apologies... It was just a small fight between kids, sorry for the trouble.”
“It's okay, I don't like seeing anyone upset.”
“You sisters are a blessing to this town.”
“Ever since you moved back here, the town has become so much livelier.”
“This is where we grew up. We just want everyone here to be happy.”
“About what I mentioned last time, have you thought about it?”
“He might be younger than you, but I think he's a fine young man!”
“No, it's okay—I'm not planning to have a boyfriend right now.”
“I see. Well, if you change your mind, remember to tell me.”
“Oh heavens... I guess I'm old, my feet ache just from walking. Better go inside and rest.”
“We've prepared some honey water for you all today. Try some!”
“Thank you, Sister Ayano. I'll be heading in now.”
“Cat's cradle? Sounds fun! Next time I'll bring a string and teach the kids.”
“Next time make some noise at least, you scared me...”
“Super annoying... asking questions all the time—not cute at all!”
“Aren't you going to ask what it is?”
“Like, I can't enjoy other people's stuff anymore.”
“After eating your snacks... all the stuff from the convenience stores stink.”
“If you want, I can keep making snacks for you?”
“While I'm here, just tell me what you want to eat.”
“So, you're really only staying until the job ends?”
“I guess so, but half a year is quite long.”
“I don't know about afterward, I'll probably do whatever Shizuko says.”
“I see... So after half a year, you'll have to work somewhere else?”
“You never get bored with that kind of life?”
“Your whole life until now, it's all been about making money, right?”
“Now that I think about it... I guess so.”
“Have you ever been to a KTV or an amusement park?”
“Hey, have you ever played cat's cradle?”
“Yeah! You can do more than just make stars!”
“No... I guess I used to hear some of the other students talk about it...”
“Let me teach you—give me your hand.”
“Yes, now watch closely—just do this... and this...”
We spent some time just chatting and having fun.
